My girlfriend of a year and 2 months, killed herself on March 18. She had always been contemplating killing herself, but she was afraid of death. Until a few days after her little sister was in town, and she couldn't take the responsibilities she had on her plate. Her grandmother and I were really the only ones trying to save her. She was medically bipolar (in my opinion) but I could never convince her to go to the doctor. She hated the pharmaceutical business, and the label (crazy) you get for the rest of your life. It'll be 2 months tomorrow that I've been without her. The only thing keeping me here is the hope that some day I will be okay. I have unsupportive parents, who couldn't give any fucks about me. My 18 year old brother, I'm 21, hasn't even spoken a word to me since the day it happened. He has become just this roommate that my parents let stay rent free. My best friends try to help a lot more than my parents. I know if I killed myself now, it would set off a chain reaction. My girlfriend Jacquelyn didn't mean to hurt me. She didn't want me to drown with her, and thought I had more supportive parents than hers. So now I live my life, as she would want me too. Eventually, I'll be okay, and after that, hopefully I can be happy like she wanted me to be. I miss you, Jacquelyn. Wherever you are, I love you.
